name: perdure
description: Checked memory skills for AI coding agents. Resume anywhere: any task, any session, any model, from a checkout. One markdown record per task, committed like code and checked like code, with a lint, a review gate, decision records, a generated HANDOFF page, and session archives.

interface.shortDescription: Committed records your agents can trust: start, work, verdict, close — resume with any model.
interface.longDescription: perdure keeps one markdown record per task in your repository — what was decided, what was set aside, what is still open — and checks it with a deterministic lint, a review gate and a generated HANDOFF page. Fourteen skills cover the lifecycle; the checks run with Python 3 from any checkout.
defaultPrompt: Read perdure/HANDOFF.md and tell me where this project stands
Start a perdure record for this task and keep it updated as we work
